    Bug 1993434 - Increase the number of mochitest chunks on debug builds. r=mkmelin
    This is probably a bit higher than necessary now, but the number of tests only gets bigger and
    this gives us some room to grow.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D268098

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
index ae0c00598c3..9d48a8bb438 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
@@ -156,6 +156,7 @@ mochitest-thunderbird:
             linux.*64-tsan.*/opt: 15
             windows1.-64.*-asan.*/opt: 9
             windows1.*-ccov.*/.*: 9
+            .*/debug: 11
             default: 7
     mozharness:
         script: desktop_unittest.py
